description: Source code for StorageBackend class implementing ISyncBackend for file storage synchronization, managing notes via Android DocumentFile API.

classes.name: StorageBackend
classes.description: Implements file storage synchronization backend for notes, handling creation, update, deletion, retrieval, and validation of note files in Android storage.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if storage location is accessible and writable.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note file in storage and returns its SyncNote representation.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note file with new content.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note file from storage.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a note from storage as a SyncNote.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all note files in storage.

methods.name: getRootDocumentFile
methods.description: Gets the root DocumentFile from storage URI.

methods.name: hasPermissionsAt
methods.description: Checks if app has read/write permissions at a given URI.

methods.name: writeNoteToFile
methods.description: Writes note content to a DocumentFile.

methods.name: getTitleFromUri
methods.description: Extracts note title from file URI.

methods.name: inStorage
methods.description: Executes a block of code with timing and exception handling.
